question: How many sales reps do we have?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT salespersonpersonid) AS sales_reps FROM wideworldimporters.sales.orders

question: What is our total invoiced revenue before tax to date?
How much stock on hand do we have in total across all products, in units?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.quantity), 0) AS total_stock_on_hand_units
FROM (
  SELECT quantity FROM wideworldimporters.legacy.crm_stock_snapshots
  UNION ALL
  SELECT quantity FROM wideworldimporters.legacy.finance_stock_snapshots
) AS s

question: What is our total gross margin in dollars on everything we have invoiced?
sql:
SELECT SUM(lineprofit) AS total_gross_margin
FROM wideworldimporters.sales.invoicelines

question: How many orders arrived late? Count an order as late when its confirmed delivery date is after the expected delivery date on the order.
sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderid) AS late_orders
FROM wideworldimporters.sales.orders o
JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.invoices i ON i.orderid = o.orderid
WHERE i.confirmeddeliverytime > o.expecteddeliverydate

question: What is our total accounts receivable right now, meaning what customers still owe us?
sql: SELECT SUM(outstandingbalance) AS total_accounts_receivable FROM wideworldimporters.sales.customertransactions

question: How much do we currently owe our vendors in total?
sql:
SELECT SUM(outstandingbalance) AS total_owed_to_vendors
FROM wideworldimporters.purchasing.suppliertransactions

question: How many products need to be kept refrigerated?
sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.name) AS refrigerated_products
FROM (
  SELECT id, name, description, category FROM wideworldimporters.legacy.crm_product_catalog_copy
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id, name, description, category FROM wideworldimporters.legacy.finance_product_catalog_copy
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id, name, description, category FROM wideworldimporters.legacy.hr_product_catalog_copy
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id, name, description, category FROM wideworldimporters.legacy.it_product_catalog_copy
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id, name, description, category FROM wideworldimporters.legacy.legal_product_catalog_copy
) p
WHERE p.description ILIKE '%refrigerat%'
   OR p.category ILIKE '%refrigerat%'
   OR p.name ILIKE '%refrigerat%'
   OR p.description ILIKE '%fridge%'
   OR p.category ILIKE '%fridge%'
   OR p.name ILIKE '%fridge%'
   OR p.description ILIKE '%chill%'
   OR p.category ILIKE '%chill%'
   OR p.name ILIKE '%chill%'
   OR p.description ILIKE '%keep cold%'
   OR p.category ILIKE '%cold%'
   OR p.name ILIKE '%cold%'

question: What promotions do we have on record? Show each promotion's description with its start date and end date.
sql:
SELECT specialdealid, dealdescription, startdate, enddate
FROM wideworldimporters.sales.specialdeals
ORDER BY specialdealid

question: Which products are below their reorder point right now? Show the product name, the units on hand and the reorder point.
sql:
SELECT si.stockitemid, si.stockitemname, h.quantityonhand AS units_on_hand, h.reorderlevel AS reorder_point
FROM wideworldimporters.warehouse.stockitemholdings h
JOIN wideworldimporters.warehouse.stockitems si ON si.stockitemid = h.stockitemid
WHERE h.quantityonhand < h.reorderlevel
ORDER BY si.stockitemname, si.stockitemid

question: How many customer orders came up short and had the remainder moved to a backorder?
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM wideworldimporters.sales.orders
WHERE isundersupplybackordered = TRUE

question: How many of our products are made in Japan?
sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS products_made_in_japan
FROM wideworldimporters.legacy.crm_product_catalog_copy
WHERE region ILIKE '%japan%'
   OR description ILIKE '%japan%'

question: How many customers are in each customer category? Show the category name and the number of customers, and leave out categories with no customers.
sql:
SELECT cc.customercategoryid, cc.customercategoryname, COUNT(c.customerid) AS customer_count
FROM wideworldimporters.sales.customers c
JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.customercategories cc ON cc.customercategoryid = c.customercategoryid
GROUP BY cc.customercategoryid, cc.customercategoryname
HAVING COUNT(c.customerid) > 0
ORDER BY customer_count DESC, cc.customercategoryname

question: Which products are in the USB Novelties group? Just give me the product names.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT name
FROM (
  SELECT name, category FROM wideworldimporters.legacy.crm_product_catalog_copy
  UNION ALL
  SELECT name, category FROM wideworldimporters.legacy.finance_product_catalog_copy
  UNION ALL
  SELECT name, category FROM wideworldimporters.legacy.hr_product_catalog_copy
  UNION ALL
  SELECT name, category FROM wideworldimporters.legacy.it_product_catalog_copy
  UNION ALL
  SELECT name, category FROM wideworldimporters.legacy.legal_product_catalog_copy
) p
WHERE category ILIKE '%USB%Novelt%'
ORDER BY name
LIMIT 500

question: For each supplier we carry products from, show the supplier name and how many products we carry from them.
sql:
SELECT s.supplierid, s.suppliername, COUNT(DISTINCT si.stockitemid) AS product_count
FROM wideworldimporters.warehouse.stockitems si
JOIN wideworldimporters.website.suppliers s ON s.supplierid = si.supplierid
GROUP BY s.supplierid, s.suppliername
ORDER BY s.suppliername, s.supplierid

question: Who is the main contact at each supplier? Show the supplier name, the contact's full name and the contact's email address.
How many customers do we deliver to in each sales territory? Show the territory and the number of customers.
What is our stock on hand worth for each product color, valued at last cost price? Show the color name and the value, and leave out products with no color.
sql:
SELECT c.colorid, c.colorname, SUM(h.quantityonhand * h.lastcostprice) AS stock_value
FROM wideworldimporters.warehouse.stockitemholdings h
JOIN wideworldimporters.warehouse.stockitems s ON s.stockitemid = h.stockitemid
JOIN wideworldimporters.warehouse.colors c ON c.colorid = s.colorid
GROUP BY c.colorid, c.colorname
ORDER BY stock_value DESC

question: Which purchase orders are still open? Show the purchase order number, the supplier name and the expected delivery date.
sql:
SELECT po.purchaseorderid, s.supplierid, s.suppliername, po.expecteddeliverydate
FROM wideworldimporters.purchasing.purchaseorders po
JOIN wideworldimporters.purchasing.suppliers s ON s.supplierid = po.supplierid
WHERE po.isorderfinalized IS FALSE
ORDER BY po.expecteddeliverydate, po.purchaseorderid

question: How many invoices went to customers in each buying group? Show the buying group name and the number of invoices, and leave out customers who are not in a group.
sql:
SELECT c.buyinggroupid, w.buyinggroupname, COUNT(DISTINCT i.invoiceid) AS invoice_count
FROM wideworldimporters.sales.invoices i
JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.customers c ON c.customerid = i.customerid
JOIN wideworldimporters.website.customers w ON w.customerid = c.customerid
WHERE c.buyinggroupid IS NOT NULL
  AND w.buyinggroupname IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.buyinggroupid, w.buyinggroupname
ORDER BY invoice_count DESC

question: How many units moved through the warehouse under each type of stock movement? Show the movement type name and the total quantity, with the sign as recorded.
sql:
SELECT category AS movement_type_name, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity
FROM (
  SELECT category, quantity FROM wideworldimporters.legacy.crm_warehouse_moves
  UNION ALL
  SELECT category, quantity FROM wideworldimporters.legacy.finance_warehouse_moves
  UNION ALL
  SELECT category, quantity FROM wideworldimporters.legacy.hr_warehouse_moves
) AS moves
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY category
LIMIT 500

question: How much have we paid each supplier in total? Show the supplier name and the amount paid as a positive number, for suppliers we have paid.
sql:
SELECT s.supplierid, s.suppliername, -SUM(t.transactionamount) AS amount_paid
FROM wideworldimporters.purchasing.suppliertransactions t
JOIN wideworldimporters.purchasing.suppliers s ON s.supplierid = t.supplierid
WHERE t.paymentmethodid IS NOT NULL
  AND t.transactionamount < 0
GROUP BY s.supplierid, s.suppliername
HAVING -SUM(t.transactionamount) > 0
ORDER BY amount_paid DESC

question: How many customers do we have?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customerid) AS customer_count FROM wideworldimporters.sales.customers

question: How many countries are in Europe?
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS country_count
FROM wideworldimporters.application.countries
WHERE continent ILIKE 'Europe'

question: What are the phone number and website of our supplier Contoso?
What is the recommended retail price of the USB rocket launcher (Gray)?
sql:
SELECT id, name, description, amount
FROM wideworldimporters.legacy.retail_price_lists
WHERE (name ILIKE '%USB%rocket%launcher%' OR description ILIKE '%USB%rocket%launcher%')
  AND (name ILIKE '%gray%' OR description ILIKE '%gray%' OR name ILIKE '%grey%' OR description ILIKE '%grey%')
LIMIT 500

question: How many temperature readings above 4.5 degrees has our refrigerated delivery vehicle logged?
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS readings_above_4_5
FROM wideworldimporters.legacy.logistics_vehicle_logs
WHERE amount > 4.5
  AND (category ILIKE '%temp%' OR name ILIKE '%temp%' OR description ILIKE '%temp%')
  AND (category ILIKE '%refrig%' OR name ILIKE '%refrig%' OR description ILIKE '%refrig%'
       OR category ILIKE '%chill%' OR name ILIKE '%chill%' OR description ILIKE '%chill%'
       OR category ILIKE '%cold%' OR name ILIKE '%cold%' OR description ILIKE '%cold%'
       OR category ILIKE '%reefer%' OR name ILIKE '%reefer%' OR description ILIKE '%reefer%')

question: How many order lines are still waiting to be picked?
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_lines_waiting_to_be_picked
FROM wideworldimporters.legacy.crm_budget_lines
WHERE order_id IS NOT NULL
  AND status ILIKE '%pick%'
  AND (status NOT ILIKE '%picked%' OR status ILIKE '%unpicked%' OR status ILIKE '%not%picked%' OR status ILIKE '%to%be%picked%')

question: How many products have a lead time longer than 14 days?
sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT stockitemid) AS products_over_14_days_lead_time
FROM wideworldimporters.warehouse.stockitems
WHERE leadtimedays > 14

question: What is the highest credit limit we have given any customer?
sql:
SELECT MAX(amount) AS highest_credit_limit
FROM wideworldimporters.legacy.crm_account_balances
WHERE category ~* 'credit[ _-]*limit'
   OR name ~* 'credit[ _-]*limit'
   OR description ~* 'credit[ _-]*limit'

question: What was our gross margin in dollars in each calendar year, going by invoice date? Show the year and the margin.
sql:
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.invoicedate)::int AS invoice_year,
       SUM(il.lineprofit) AS gross_margin
FROM wideworldimporters.sales.invoicelines il
JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.invoices i ON i.invoiceid = il.invoiceid
GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.invoicedate)
ORDER BY invoice_year

question: How many orders did we take in each month of 2015? Show the month number and the number of orders.
sql:
SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.orderdate)::int AS month_number, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderid) AS order_count
FROM wideworldimporters.sales.orders o
WHERE o.orderdate >= DATE '2015-01-01' AND o.orderdate < DATE '2016-01-01'
GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.orderdate)
ORDER BY month_number

question: By what percentage did invoiced revenue before tax grow from 2014 to 2015, going by invoice date? Round to one decimal place.
sql:
WITH line_totals AS (
  SELECT invoiceid, SUM(extendedprice - taxamount) AS revenue_before_tax
  FROM wideworldimporters.sales.invoicelines
  GROUP BY invoiceid
),
yearly AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.invoicedate) AS invoice_year,
         SUM(l.revenue_before_tax) AS revenue
  FROM wideworldimporters.sales.invoices i
  JOIN line_totals l ON l.invoiceid = i.invoiceid
  WHERE i.invoicedate >= DATE '2014-01-01'
    AND i.invoicedate < DATE '2016-01-01'
  GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.invoicedate)
)
SELECT ROUND(
  (SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_year = 2015 THEN revenue END) - SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_year = 2014 THEN revenue END))
  / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_year = 2014 THEN revenue END), 0) * 100, 1
) AS revenue_growth_pct
FROM yearly

question: How much money did we receive in customer payments between January 1 and March 31, 2016?
sql:
SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_customer_payments
FROM wideworldimporters.legacy.finance_payment_runs
WHERE created_at >= '2016-01-01'
  AND created_at < '2016-04-01'
  AND category ILIKE '%customer%'

question: How many cold room temperature readings went above 4.5 degrees in February 2016?
sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT coldroomtemperatureid) AS readings_above_4_5
FROM (
  SELECT coldroomtemperatureid, recordedwhen, temperature
  FROM wideworldimporters.warehouse.coldroomtemperatures
  UNION ALL
  SELECT coldroomtemperatureid, recordedwhen, temperature
  FROM wideworldimporters.warehouse.coldroomtemperatures_archive
) t
WHERE t.temperature > 4.5
  AND t.recordedwhen >= TIMESTAMP '2016-02-01'
  AND t.recordedwhen < TIMESTAMP '2016-03-01'

question: Who were our top 5 customers by invoiced revenue before tax in 2015? Count each store on its own, not rolled up to its head office. Show the customer name and the revenue.
sql:
SELECT c.customerid, c.customername, SUM(il.extendedprice - il.taxamount) AS invoiced_revenue
FROM wideworldimporters.sales.invoicelines il
JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.invoices i ON i.invoiceid = il.invoiceid
JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.customers c ON c.customerid = i.customerid
WHERE i.invoicedate >= DATE '2015-01-01' AND i.invoicedate < DATE '2016-01-01'
GROUP BY c.customerid, c.customername
ORDER BY invoiced_revenue DESC
LIMIT 5

question: Which sales rep brought in the most invoiced sales including tax in 2015? Show their full name and the amount.
sql:
SELECT p.personid, p.fullname, SUM(il.extendedprice) AS invoiced_sales_incl_tax
FROM wideworldimporters.sales.invoicelines il
JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.invoices i ON i.invoiceid = il.invoiceid
JOIN wideworldimporters.application.people p ON p.personid = i.salespersonpersonid
WHERE i.invoicedate >= DATE '2015-01-01' AND i.invoicedate < DATE '2016-01-01'
GROUP BY p.personid, p.fullname
ORDER BY invoiced_sales_incl_tax DESC
LIMIT 1

question: What are our top 10 products by units invoiced, all time? Show the product name and the units invoiced.
sql:
SELECT il.stockitemid, MIN(il.description) AS product_name, SUM(il.quantity) AS units_invoiced
FROM wideworldimporters.sales.invoicelines il
GROUP BY il.stockitemid
ORDER BY units_invoiced DESC
LIMIT 10

question: What share of our invoiced revenue before tax comes from refrigerated products? Give it as a percentage rounded to two decimal places.
sql:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.ischillerstock IS TRUE THEN il.extendedprice ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(il.extendedprice), 0), 2) AS refrigerated_revenue_share_pct
FROM wideworldimporters.sales.invoicelines il
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT stockitemid, BOOL_OR(ischillerstock) AS ischillerstock
  FROM wideworldimporters.warehouse.stockitems
  GROUP BY stockitemid
) s ON s.stockitemid = il.stockitemid

question: Which employee has picked the most orders? Show their full name and the number of orders picked.
sql:
SELECT p.personid, p.fullname, COUNT(o.orderid) AS orders_picked
FROM wideworldimporters.sales.orders o
JOIN wideworldimporters.application.people p ON p.personid = o.pickedbypersonid
WHERE p.isemployee = TRUE
GROUP BY p.personid, p.fullname
ORDER BY orders_picked DESC
LIMIT 1
